name: partners-catalogs-marketing-publication
executionConcern: Partner/Store onboarding and publication, catalog governance/media/reels, marketing/discovery gates and direct Client/Partner/Field readback
objective: Converge onboarding, catalog and discovery publication on one DSH-owned state model while preserving WLT payout ownership and direct multi-surface consistency.
truthOwner: DSH owns Partner/Store, catalog and operational publication/discovery truth; WLT exclusively owns payout destination and monetary truth; Control Panel is an operator surface only.

tasks.objective: Close Partner/Store onboarding, approval, ownership and publication
tasks.currentProblem: List/detail/store/readiness state can diverge across operator, Field, Partner and Client if trusted context or publication gates are duplicated outside DSH.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Partner list/detail/stores, evidence review and transitions to DSH contracts/backend/database; derive trusted context server-side, enforce business/object scope, ownership uniqueness, expected version and idempotency, and return canonical readiness/publication readback.
tasks.targetState: One traceable Partner/Store lifecycle drives operator decisions and direct Field/Partner/Client consequences without silent Store reassignment or raw payout data in DSH.
tasks.action: Repair the earliest owner/invariant defect, migrate affected adapters, remove duplicate readiness/publication truth and keep payout details as WLT references only.
mustNotChange: Do not allow client-controlled trusted context.
Do not reassign an already owned Store through generic onboarding.
Do not persist raw payout account identifiers in DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: List/detail/nested routes enforce identical authorization and business scope.
Stale, duplicate and forbidden transitions fail explicitly and canonically.
Direct Partner/Field/Client readbacks converge on committed Partner/Store state and publication gates.
tasks.rollback: Use forward DSH lifecycle correction for persisted state and preserve audit/ownership evidence; never restore a known cross-scope or Store-reassignment defect.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Partner/Store owner and publication commit with database/contract changes only when root cause requires them.

tasks.objective: Close catalog governance, media/reels review and publication
tasks.currentProblem: Catalog/category/product/availability/reel approval can become optimistic or locally divergent, including hidden governance routes and operator media preview.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Control Panel catalog and shared catalog/reels APIs to DSH owner state; enforce operator/object scope, review transitions, conflict/idempotency for mutations, safe media authorization, and Partner/Client publication readback.
tasks.targetState: Taxonomy, products, availability and governed reels expose one DSH-owned publication state across operator, Partner and Client consumers.
tasks.action: Correct shared/controller/backend/database bindings, remove duplicate local catalog truth and verify search/filter/bulk operations cannot cross scope.
mustNotChange: Do not authorize media preview from UI state alone.
Do not publish unapproved or unready catalog state to clients.
Do not create a second catalog source in Marketing or a mobile app.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog/reel mutations return canonical DSH readback and reject stale/forbidden scope.
Hidden governance route and bulk/search/filter paths preserve scope.
Partner/Client visibility matches committed approval/publication state.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation-only changes if safe; roll forward at DSH for persisted publication/review effects while retaining audit.

tasks.objective: Close Marketing/discovery as a governed publication consumer
tasks.currentProblem: Marketing/discovery can accidentally duplicate catalog visibility or financial funding truth and report successful publication before all gates are committed.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace campaigns/coupons/discovery visibility to the canonical DSH/WLT owners required by each operation, with explicit source, scope, state and readback; remove local final-truth calculations.
tasks.targetState: Marketing influences discovery only through governed owner state and cannot bypass Store/catalog/serviceability or financial boundaries.
tasks.action: Repair owner binding and publication predicates, then verify client discovery reflects all applicable gates and dependency failures are explicit.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate WLT financial truth in Marketing.
Do not create a parallel catalog/publication status.
Do not turn dependency failure into visible success.
acceptanceCriteria: Marketing state has an explicit owner and audit/readback where mutated.
Client discovery never bypasses applicable Partner/Store/catalog/serviceability gates.
Unavailable/forbidden/conflict states remain visible and recoverable.
tasks.rollback: Roll forward at the canonical owner for persisted campaign/publication state; never restore a bypass gate.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Marketing/discovery binding commit after Partner/catalog ownership is correct.
